text.tspan: Payload: { recipientName, recipientPhone, deliveryAddress, deliveryFee: 20000, items: [...] }
[Dữ liệu không hợp lệ (Ví dụ: Thiếu địa chỉ / SĐT sai)]
[Nhánh A1: Khách Chuyển Khoản Thành Công]

g.text: [Nhánh A2: Đơn Giao Hàng Quá Hạn Quét Mã 10 Phút]

svg.text: Quét QR Delivery / Truy cập Web Delivery
Nhập Họ tên: "Trần Thị Lan", SĐT: "0988776655", Địa chỉ: "Tòa Diamond Plaza, 34 Lê Duẩn, Q1"
Chọn 2x Trà Đào Cam Sả Size L (80.000đ)
Tự động cộng Phí giao hàng cố định: +20.000đ -> Tổng thanh toán: 100.000đ
Bấm chọn [Thanh toán VietQR & Đặt Giao Hàng]
POST /api/v1/orders/delivery
Forward Request
FluentValidation: Kiểm tra Phone Regex & Length(Address) >= 10 & DeliveryFee == 20000
HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity (RFC 7807 ProblemDetails: "Địa chỉ giao hàng không hợp lệ")
Báo lỗi trên Form nhập liệu
RedLock.AcquireAsync("lock:inventory:branch:B01", expire=5s)
SELECT r.ingredient_id, r.quantity FROM product_recipes r WHERE r.product_id='prod-tra-dao' AND r.size_id='size-L'
RecipeData { TraDao: 30g, DaoNgam: 50g, CamTuoi: 40g } (x2 Ly = 60g Trà, 100g Đào, 80g Cam)
SELECT s.ingredient_id, s.current_quantity FROM inventory_stocks s WHERE s.branch_id='B01' AND s.ingredient_id IN ('ing-tea', 'ing-peach', 'ing-orange')
CurrentStockData { Tra: 3000g, Dao: 2000g, Cam: 1500g }
HGETALL inventory:reserved:B01
ReservedData { Tra: 100g, Dao: 200g, Cam: 100g }
Kiểm tra: current_quantity - reserved_stock >= required_qty (Đủ hàng)
HINCRBY inventory:reserved:B01 ing-tea 60
HINCRBY inventory:reserved:B01 ing-peach 100
HINCRBY inventory:reserved:B01 ing-orange 80
EXPIRE inventory:reserved:B01 600
RedLock.ReleaseAsync("lock:inventory:branch:B01")
BEGIN TRANSACTION

INSERT INTO orders (order_code='DEL-B01-0055', branch_id='B01', order_type='DELIVERY', status='PendingPayment', sub_total=80000, delivery_fee=20000, total_amount=100000, expires_at=NOW()+INTERVAL '10 min')
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, size_id, quantity=2, unit_price=40000, total_price=80000, status='PendingPayment')

INSERT INTO delivery_orders (order_id, recipient_name='Trần Thị Lan', recipient_phone='0988776655', delivery_address='Tòa Diamond Plaza, 34 Lê Duẩn, Q1', delivery_fee=20000, delivery_status='PendingPayment')
INSERT INTO payments (order_id, payment_method='VIETQR', amount=100000, status='Pending', transfer_content='DEL_B01_0055')
COMMIT TRANSACTION
POST /v2/payment-requests (Amount=100000, Description="DEL_B01_0055")
Trả về PaymentLink (PaymentLinkId="plink_9912", QrCodeDataUrl, CheckoutUrl)
HTTP 201 Created (OrderId="del-0055", QrCodeUrl, TotalAmount=100000, ExpiresAt="10:00")
Hiển thị mã VietQR 100.000 VNĐ kèm đồng hồ đếm ngược 10:00
Mở App Ngân Hàng -> Quét QR -> Chuyển 100.000đ
POST /api/v1/webhooks/payos (HMAC-SHA256, DEL_B01_0055, 100000đ)
Forward Webhook
Verify HMAC-SHA256 & Idempotency Key (SETNX lock:webhook:payos:DEL_B01_0055 EX 60)
BEGIN TRANSACTION
UPDATE payments SET status='Success', confirmed_at=NOW() WHERE transfer_content='DEL_B01_0055'
INSERT INTO transactions (payment_id, gateway_transaction_id=..., amount=100000, is_verified=true)
UPDATE orders SET status='Confirmed', paid_at=NOW() WHERE id='del-0055'
UPDATE delivery_orders SET delivery_status='Preparing' WHERE order_id='del-0055'
UPDATE inventory_stocks SET current_quantity = current_quantity - 60 WHERE branch_id='B01' AND ingredient_id='ing-tea'
UPDATE inventory_stocks SET current_quantity = current_quantity - 100 WHERE branch_id='B01' AND ingredient_id='ing-peach'
UPDATE inventory_stocks SET current_quantity = current_quantity - 80 WHERE branch_id='B01' AND ingredient_id='ing-orange'
INSERT INTO inventory_logs (branch_id, ingredient_id, order_id, change_type='BOM_AUTO_DEDUCT', quantity_changed=-60, notes='Deducted for del-0055')
INSERT INTO inventory_logs (branch_id, ingredient_id, order_id, change_type='BOM_AUTO_DEDUCT', quantity_changed=-100, notes='Deducted for del-0055')
INSERT INTO inventory_logs (branch_id, ingredient_id, order_id, change_type='BOM_AUTO_DEDUCT', quantity_changed=-80, notes='Deducted for del-0055')
COMMIT TRANSACTION
HINCRBY inventory:reserved:B01 ing-tea -60
HINCRBY inventory:reserved:B01 ing-peach -100
HINCRBY inventory:reserved:B01 ing-orange -80
OrderHub.Clients.Group("order_del-0055").SendAsync("PaymentReceived", { orderId: "del-0055" })
KitchenHub.Clients.Group("branch_B01_kitchen").SendAsync("NewKitchenOrder", DeliveryTicketDto)
HTTP 200 OK
Event `PaymentReceived` -> PWA: "Thanh toán thành công! Quán đang pha chế & đóng gói 🛵"
KDS hiện vé `[DELIVERY
UPDATE orders SET status='Cancelled' WHERE id='del-0055'
UPDATE delivery_orders SET delivery_status='Cancelled' WHERE order_id='del-0055'
HINCRBY inventory:reserved:B01 ing-tea -60
HINCRBY inventory:reserved:B01 ing-peach -100
HINCRBY inventory:reserved:B01 ing-orange -80
OrderHub.Clients.Group("order_del-0055").SendAsync("OrderExpired", { orderId: "del-0055" })
PATCH /api/v1/kds/orders/del-0055/status { status: "Preparing" }
Pha chế đồ uống -> Dán tem nắp ly chống tràn -> Đóng túi niêm phong -> Dán tem địa chỉ
PATCH /api/v1/kds/orders/del-0055/status { status: "Ready" }
UPDATE delivery_orders SET delivery_status='ReadyForPickup' WHERE order_id='del-0055'
NotificationHub.Clients.Group("branch_B01_staff").SendAsync("DeliveryReadyForPickup", "del-0055")
Nhận túi đồ uống niêm phong
PATCH /api/v1/delivery/del-0055/assign-driver { driverName: "Lê Văn Hùng", driverPhone: "0912345678" }
UPDATE delivery_orders SET driver_name='Lê Văn Hùng', driver_phone='0912345678', delivery_status='Delivering', dispatched_at=NOW() WHERE order_id='del-0055'
Vận chuyển đến "Tòa Diamond Plaza, 34 Lê Duẩn, Q1" -> Giao tận tay khách hàng
POST /api/v1/orders/del-0055/delivery-complete
UPDATE delivery_orders SET delivery_status='Delivered', delivered_at=NOW() WHERE order_id='del-0055'
UPDATE orders SET status='Completed', completed_at=NOW() WHERE id='del-0055'
OrderHub.Clients.Group("order_del-0055").SendAsync("OrderStatusUpdated", "Completed")
PWA thông báo: "Đơn hàng đã giao thành công! Chúc bạn thưởng thức ngon miệng 🎉"
